title: Mount begin waits for a player step and binds the current follower

verification.actor: MOUNTED species 56 (mankey), acquired through mount; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Start a normal player run, press Select during the tile step, then request one Hop after the current follower mounts
verification.observable: The stock player step finishes before mount control begins; the same Mankey completes one later Hop and moves beyond the run tile; each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result; control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels

setupMutations.change: Shared prepared native spawn of saved Igglybuff 174 party slot 3 as previous follower. No profile or timer writes. After record start, normal Y opens saved highlight 2 and Y confirms Mankey 56. Wait for that exact current follower to settle, start a normal player run, then press Select during the tile step.

limits: Prepared previous-follower setup cannot prove natural spawning. The three native Y/Y/Select edges occur after setup with normal timers and unchanged profiles.
One full same-subject Hop after a moving Select proves this handoff and control witness, not general movement timing or a soak.

Public producer contract: Hop motionKind is 2 for START and COMMIT/FINISH. CONTROL_RETURNED valueA is mounted inputOwnership 1, not the Wild value 0. ACTOR_REBOUND reports roles 2 to 3; CONTROL_REBOUND reports input owners 0 to 1.

events.value: Select a follower different from the previous follower
Start a normal player run, then press Select during its tile step
Request one Hop with the rebound current follower

stop.condition: The player step finishes, then the same current follower mounts and completes exactly one Hop, or first missing/invalid native observation

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
